public.title: Maximum Stock Profit
public.description: prices gives a stock price for each day in order. Return the maximum profit from buying once and selling on a later day. You may skip trading, giving profit 0. The array has 0 to 1000 integer prices between 0 and 1000000. Aim for linear time.
hints: Keep the cheapest earlier price and the best profit so far.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Scan prices in day order, tracking the smallest price seen and the largest gain from selling today. Starting profit at zero handles falling prices and short inputs. Time is O(n), space O(1).
